name: Auto Node Translate Libre
description: A LibreTranslate translation provider plugin for the Auto Node Translate module (machine translation of node content).
project_description: Adds LibreTranslate as a translation provider for the Auto Node Translate module. It contributes a single AutoNodeTranslateProvider plugin ('auto_node_translate_libre') that sends node field text to a configurable LibreTranslate server (endpoint URL and API key set at admin/config/regional/libre) and returns the translated string. LibreTranslate is a free, open-source, self-hostable machine-translation engine, so this provider is attractive for keeping content off commercial APIs.
